checks.reason: No explicit plan to consult prior burden/enrichment Methods or versioned documentation to select detailed analysis conditions and verify transfer before execution. Citation/provenance lookup is separate.

Does not define a complete primary burden/enrichment estimand and model with uncertainty and a declared multiplicity family. Generic calibrated p-values, prespecification or parameter lists do not provide those inferential choices.
Explains aggregate variant burden, differential ascertainment and the eligible/testable-gene enrichment null rather than equating a small p-value with pathway causation.

checks.quote: Loss of statistical significance alone would be inconclusive
checks.reason: Explicitly distinguishes attenuated/reversed effects from imprecise nonsignificance and states what balanced replication would and would not resolve.

Specifies a genuinely independent cohort or balanced resequencing comparison, with common callability/filtering and ancestry/technical comparability; preserves association-versus-mechanism uncertainty.

checks.quote: merely adding a center covariate cannot separate their effects
checks.reason: Explicitly identifies complete confounding, requires balanced new data, and proposes comparable ancestry/callability, kinship handling and eligible-universe robustness.
